name: InteractiveHtmlBom
description: Interactive BOM generator with PnP marking (jpkh fork)
description_full: Generates a convenient, visually correlated Bill of Materials (BOM) page for a PCB. This fork of openscopeproject/InteractiveHtmlBom adds a 'Show PnP components' checkbox column: parts whose value and footprint match a Ki-Qihe component mapping file are pre-marked in a PnP column shown after 'Placed', and the marks survive an Interactive HTML reset. All other behavior stays in sync with upstream.
